scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ask-jev/shared build && pnpm --filter ask-jev build && pnpm --filter playground build && pnpm --filter api build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @ask-jev/shared build && pnpm --filter ask-jev build && pnpm --filter playground build && pnpm --parallel --filter @ask-jev/shared --filter ask-jev --filter api --filter playground dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ask-jev/shared build && pnpm --filter ask-jev build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @ask-jev/shared build && pnpm --filter ask-jev build && pnpm -r test
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.deploy: pnpm check && pnpm --filter api run deploy
